title: See through thin, low quality fabric
text:
See through thin, low quality fabric. These are seriously thin - to the point of being see through. I would never subject my guests to these cheap sheets, that's like saying get out of our home as soon as possible. On the positive side, being excessively thin, these are cool on a hot, Texas summer night.

I've washed this set once and nothing came apart. We're just using these on the mattress in the sleeper of the big rig truck and not in our home. As truck sheets, if the fall apart, it's not a big deal and throwing the truck sheets away is expected.
